name: Strict-load or environment refusals
action: Fix the key mismatch, or restart with --allow-env-change after a person approves the change.

name: Main run held (exit 78 / crash loop)
action: Read the job.held cause; rollback or fix, then release.

name: Main-run interruptions per day
action: Group incidents by node and cause_class; drain repeat offenders.

name: Goodput of the main run
action: See the largest non-productive bucket in the report.

name: Step watchdog fired (hang)
action: Read the stack dump in the job log and the NCCL flight-recorder trace; drain the rank that stopped.

name: Spot interruption notice
action: Automatic: drain + save + requeue. Page only if no commit within 90 s.

name: Loss-spike guard trips
action: Look at the batches before the spike; rollback: --from-step <last good> --skip N --branch <new>.

name: Cost per productive GPU-hour vs list price
Wasted share of main-run spend
action: The report lists each bucket in USD.

name: Cost of one incident
action: Large values: missing emergency save, slow restore, or no spare.

name: Crash-loop holds
action: Read the logs of the 3 crashes; for the main run this is also Q-02 (high).

name: Drained nodes
action: Re-test with --full; repair, replace or stop the instance.

name: Human interventions
action: Automate the step that needed a person.

name: Straggler ratio (rank step time / median)
action: Medium for 3 windows: drain at the next checkpoint.

name: Time since last committed checkpoint
action: Check checkpoint.failed events; if saves fail, fix storage before the next failure costs a full interval.

name: Compute dollars at risk (since last commit)
action: Same as CK-01. Thresholds are multiples of the cost of one interval.

name: Work lost per incident
action: Check that SIGUSR1/SIGTERM reached the trainer and the emergency save committed.

name: Jobs rejected for no valid account
action: Check the submit system's account mapping.
